label: NPort 6650-16 16-port secure terminal server
description: 16-port RS-232/422/485 terminal server with one 10/100BaseT(X) RJ45 uplink, a dedicated RS-232 console port, and secure operation modes (SSHv2, TLS 1.2, RADIUS/TACACS+) for attaching terminals, modems and console cables to the network.
notes: Moxa NPort 6400/6600 Series datasheet v1.7: 'Ethernet Interface - 10/100BaseT(X) Ports (RJ45 connector): 1, Auto MDI/MDI-X connection'; 'Serial Interface - Connector: NPort 6600 models: 8-pin RJ45; No. of Ports: NPort 6600-16 models: 16'; 'Console Port: NPort 6600 models: RS-232 (TxD, RxD, GND), 8-pin RJ45 (19200, n, 8, 1)'. Secure modes include Secure Real COM, Secure TCP client/server, Reverse SSH and Secure Pair Connection, with RADIUS/TACACS+ authentication and AES-256/HMAC - the difference from the 5650-16, which has a local database only. Extra Ethernet ports on this family come from NM-TX01/NM-TX02 expansion modules (1 or 2 further 10/100 ports) and are deliberately not modelled: they are an option, and the notes on this catalogue's other parts follow the same rule of only modelling what ships by default. 6600-32 models exist with 32 serial ports but were not added; the 16-port unit is the one that matches a standard 19-inch patch-panel build.
